question: Which of the following teams won the 9th Pro Kabaddi League 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Jaipur Pink Panthers.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jaipur Pink Panthers team was formed in 2014.
 
• It is owned by Bollywood actor **Abhishek Bachhann**.
 
• Their home ground is Sawai Maan Singh Stadium Jaipur.
 
• The team has won Pro Kabaddi league title in 2014.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kabaddi is sport originated in India. The hindi meaning** "Holding Hands"**
 
• It is played between two teams consisting of 7 pl**ayers in each team.**
 
• **Some important tournaments are: **Pro Kabaddi League, Kabaddi world Cup, Asian Games, Southa Asian Games, Kabaddi masters, Federation Cup, Super Kabaddi League.
 
• The terms related to Kabaddi are: **Raid, Defense, Scoring, Duration**.
